_comment: Curated starter list for myNews. Fetched by the app on first start and cached locally; nothing is bundled (project_description.md section 10). Compiled by hand from each publisher's own feed page -- do not bulk-import a third party's feed directory (section 87a UrhG). Every entry states its language, because section 7 assigns languages rather than detecting them. Removing a publisher on request is a commit to this file, not an app release. 'description' is English, the source language; 'description_<lang>' overrides it, same convention as the UI translations.
